You can <$cdef(27)>climb up to high places by stacking terrain

<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,27)><$facial(4,4)>Thanks for going to check for me! Well? Find anything
interesting up there?

<$voicel(2,3)>You see that rock wall over there?
<$voicel(2,5)>I’m so curious about what’s on the other side!

<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)><$cdef(27)>If we could smash that wall, I bet we could see what’s
on the other side...
<$comeff(2,6)><$voicel(2,8)>Do you think you could do that,
<$cdef(27)>?

<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,13)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Wait, really?! You can use <$cdef(27)><$sklname;0(4)>?!
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,1)>... ... ...
... ... ...
<$comeff(2,1)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Awww... I guess not after all, huh?

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,12)>You know, I bet we could smash right through that wall if
one of us could <$cdef(27)>use the move <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)>...
<$voicel(2,4)>But I guess that’s not happening, huh?

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>So you found a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2793)>, huh? That’s great!
<$comeff(4,17)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,3)>...Not that I have any idea what that thing does.
<$comeff(4,1)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>But I got a feeling you’ll have no problem figuring out how
to use it.
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,10)>In any case, knowing what was up there’s a huge weight
off my mind. Thanks, <$cdef(27)>!

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,9)>You know...a long time ago, <$voicel(2,6)>I actually met a Pokémon
who was really good at <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)>!

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,13)>They were always training with a <$cdef(27)>punching bag...
<$voicel(2,8)>They looked so cool—even when they were just taking a
break on a <$cdef(27)>bench!

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,18)>I really shoulda learned <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)> from them when
I had the chance...
<$voicel(2,4)>Then again, I guess my arms are too short for that kind
of thing.

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>If you ever learn <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)>, <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>let’s go check out the
other side of that wall together!

always train with a <$cdef(27)>punching bag... <$voicel(2,8)><$comcan(2)><$motion(2,803)>And then they’d rest

you’re amazing, <$cdef(27)>!
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,1)>Then let’s go see what’s on <$cdef(27)>the other side of that wall</color>!

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh, look—there’s a cave over there!
<$voicel(2,6)>It looks way too scary though... I think I’ll stay here.

It’s way too spooky!
